notes: Flare is a VRM 0.x model. @pixiv/three-vrm normalizes its VRM0 presets to the canonical VRM 1.0 expression names at load (joy->happy, sorrow->sad, fun->relaxed, angry->angry, a/i/u/e/o->aa/ih/ou/ee/oh). 'surprised' has no VRM0 source and is added at runtime by surprisedSynthesis.ts.

lip_sync.notes: Standard VRM A/I/U/E/O viseme set, exposed by three-vrm as aa/ih/ou/ee/oh.
